cd /app/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, random
rng = random.Random(7)
P, R, D = 8, 128, 32
inputs = [[[rng.randint(-10**9,10**9) for _ in range(D)] for _ in range(R)] for _ in range(P)]
events = []
pending = []
nid = 0
for i in range(20000):
    k = rng.random()
    if k < 0.25:
        events.append(["send", rng.randrange(P), rng.randrange(R)])
        pending.append(nid); nid += 1
    elif k < 0.3:
        events.append(["retry", rng.randrange(P)])
    elif pending and k < 0.95:
        j = rng.randrange(len(pending))
        pid = pending.pop(j)
        events.append(["deliver", pid])
    elif pending:
        pid = pending.pop(rng.randrange(len(pending)))
        events.append(["drop", pid])
    else:
        events.append(["retry", 0])
# limit pending growth: trim
req = {"op":"replay","inputs":inputs,"slots":16,"window":16,"events":events}
open("maxrep2.jsonl","w").write(json.dumps(req)+"\n")
print("events:", len(events))
PYEOF
time python3 -I /app/submission/main.py < maxrep2.jsonl | wc -c
